district_name: Kingdom East Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(D) inventory: Kingdom East Supervisory District -- the Kingdom East Unified Union School District is its own supervisory district (member towns: Burke, Concord, Lunenburg, Lyndon, Newark, Sheffield, Sutton, Wheelock). Formed July 1, 2018; operates PK-8 and tuitions grades 9-12.

sources.note: Kingdom East UUSD: fifteen directors, seats allocated by town residency across the eight member towns, elected by the whole district electorate on a single commingled Australian ballot (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) modified at-large). NO memberships are minted yet: the current roster could not be tied to any fetched official document -- the board page roster does not extract as text, and the district's 2026 Annual Report PDF returned an empty body. The only firsthand-verified current member is Chair Lindsay Carpenter (district superintendent-search page). The exact resolving documents are the 2026 KESD Annual Report (which should also carry the per-town allocation and the March 3, 2026 warning) and the Articles of Agreement adopted March 7, 2017. A Newark seat fell vacant in fall 2025 (to be appointed until the March 3, 2026 election, per the district's November 2025 board flyer). Kingdom East School District board page (official): "The fifteen-member Board, with representation from our eight member towns." The district's Revised 2023 Warning warns all eight towns to one district vote; the district states its votes "are commingled and not reported by town" (2019 bond post); the 2021 Annual Report warning (Article 3) elects directors by residency seat (that year: Concord, Lunenburg, Lyndon, Newark, Sutton x2, Wheelock) by Australian ballot -- the 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) modified at-large pattern.
